info.name: Create and sign in a sandbox user

items.docs:
Create a sandbox user and sign in.
    **Authentication Required**: Must be logged in with a @wispr.ai email address.
    This endpoint:
    1. Creates a Supabase user with @wispr.test email
    2. Creates all necessary database records with onboarding NOT completed
    3. Returns auth tokens for immediate sign-in

Destroy a sandbox user by deleting all associated data from all tables and services.
    This endpoint:
    1. Validates the user has a @wispr.test email
    2. Checks if user is the only member of an enterprise and deletes the enterprise if so
    3. Uses the existing compliance-ready user deletion service
    4. Deletes data from: main DB (incl. Subscription via CASCADE), usage DB, Customer.io, Segment, PostHog, ClickHouse
    5. Cancels any active subscriptions via Stripe
    6. Deletes from
